name: Model:Cycles
summary: Six-track FM groovebox. Its OS file is documented and rebuilt byte for byte, and modified builds boot on units. No shared core yet.

research.label: elektron-firmware-tool
research.note: Documents the OS container, SysEx transport, packing and HMAC trailer, and reads Model:Cycles files. Its repack rebuilds the stock OS 1.13 file byte for byte.

research.label: Modded-Cycles
research.note: Research notes, address map and emulated tests for Model:Cycles OS 1.13, modified builds flashed on units, and recovery through the startup menu with the stock file.

research.label: Model-TG
research.note: Extensive modification of Model:Cycles OS 1.13, including a sampler machine, built and signed by its own flasher and run on units.

research.label: elektron-model-tweaks
research.note: Byte-level tweaks for Model:Cycles and Model:Samples OS 1.13, each listing the original and the new bytes.
